in_hindi.name: Miton

in_tamil.name: Mitun
in_tamil.long_meaning: Mitun ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mitra’, meaning ‘friend’. In Hindu mythology, Mitra is a deity associated with friendship, treaties, and contracts.

in_telugu.name: Mitun
in_telugu.long_meaning: Mitun ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mitra’, meaning ‘friend’. In Hindu mythology, Mitra is a deity associated with friendship, treaties, and contracts.

in_bengali.name: Mitun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Mitun একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mitra’, meaning ‘friend’. In Hindu mythology, Mitra is a deity associated with friendship, treaties, and contracts.
